Book correction: In the second line of proof (ii) the book prints "os 2α cos α" (the letter c is missing). It is \cos 2\alpha\cos\alpha - \sin 2\alpha\sin\alpha, the expansion of \cos(2\alpha + \alpha).

Book correction: In Example 12(ii), in the step where numerator and denominator are divided by \cos^{2}\theta, the book prints the denominator as \cos^{2}\theta + \sin 2\theta. It must be \cos^{2}\theta + \sin^{2}\theta (which equals 1); the next printed step already uses \frac{\sin^{2}\theta}{\cos^{2}\theta}.
